wizard.title: Welcome to Attic
wizard.subtitle: Three quick steps — everything stays changeable in Settings later.
wizard.dirDefaultHint: Game data lives in your user profile — unaffected by updates or uninstalls.
wizard.dirCustomHint: Pick any folder outside the install directory — the uninstaller deletes everything inside it.
wizard.dirPending: New data folder applies after restarting the app: {path}
wizard.dirLocalTitle: Folder next to the app (travels with it)
wizard.dirLocalHint: Game data lives in .attic beside the app folder — copy the folder anywhere and the data follows.
wizard.dirLocalFallback: The app folder is not writable right now — data temporarily lives in the standard location (see the title-bar badge).
wizard.dirDefaultHintPortable: Game data lives in your user profile — the portable folder stays light, but the data does not travel with it.
wizard.dirCustomHintPortable: Pick any location — the pointer is written into portable.ini inside the pack and travels with it; relative paths resolve against the app folder.
wizard.accountsEmpty: No account yet — create an offline one to start playing.
wizard.accountsSkipHint: Leave empty to skip; accounts can be added anytime.
wizard.javaNone: No suitable Java 8 found. The app can fetch one on launch, or pick manually.

portable.warnNonAscii: Data root path contains non-ASCII characters — legacy Java 8 / LWJGL2 may garble or fail to launch (warning only).
portable.warnSpace: Data root path contains spaces — some legacy launch chains mishandle them (warning only).
portable.warnLong: Data root path is very long (240+ chars) — it may hit the 260 limit and break file operations (warning only).
portable.fallbackTooltip: App folder is not writable — data temporarily lives at: {path}
portable.recoverHint: The portable breadcrumb points to another data root: {path} — if your data lives there, change the data folder and restart the app.

account.title: Accounts
account.hint: Select an account to view or edit its settings.

dialog.subtitle: Choose the account type to add.
dialog.msDesc: Sign in with a Microsoft account and get your skin.
dialog.usernameValidation: Username must be 3–16 letters, digits or underscores.

renameDialog.title: Rename account
renameDialog.subtitle: Enter the new username; the offline UUID will be regenerated.

removeDialog.title: Remove account
removeDialog.message: Remove account "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

custom.title: Custom Versions
custom.hint: Select a custom version to edit its configuration.
custom.emptyHint: Click "Import jar" to add a custom version.
custom.launchMethodRequired: launch-method is required; other fields are optional (left blank saves as `key=`).
custom.notDetected: Could not detect a launch method; set launch-method or main-class manually.
custom.modHint: This mod version’s .info is managed by the Mods repository: only viewing details and deleting are available here (deleting also clears the install registry). Editing is disabled.

removeDialog.title: Delete custom version
removeDialog.message: Delete "{id}"? Its jar and .info configuration will be removed. This cannot be undone.
removeDialog.affected: {n} instance(s) use it; after deletion they fall back to “No version selected” and need a new pick before launching.

custom.externalChanged: This .info was modified by an external editor; your unsaved changes will not be overwritten.

mods.title: Mods
mods.sourceHint: Phase 1 ships the official Betacraft repository only (getmods.jsp); adding other sources is not available yet.
mods.hint: "Download" fetches the .info metadata only; the mod jar and base assembly are completed automatically when you press Play.
mods.loadError: Failed to load the mod repository

external.openErrorHint: Check that a default browser is configured on your system (the host refuses to open when no http/https association is registered).

bridge.missing: No IPC bridge — running in a plain browser. Data is mocked; launch is unavailable.

version.pickHint: Click to expand the version list.

instance.emptyHint: Create one to keep a separate instance directory per version.
instance.pickHint: Click to expand the instance list.
instance.name: Name
instance.hint: Pick an instance on the left, or create a new one.
instance.activateHint: The Play button on the launch page will use this instance.

deleteDialog.title: Delete instance
deleteDialog.message: This removes the profile of instance "{name}".
deleteDialog.withFiles: Also delete the instance directory (saves included, not recoverable)

vsync.name: VSync
vsync.desc: Sync rendering with the display refresh rate to reduce tearing (-Dlf.vsync).

visualizer.name: Infinite Map Visualizer
visualizer.desc: Launch this session with the bird-eye view Infinite Map Visualizer; only meaningful around inf-20100616 to b1.3 (-Dlf.visualizer, not persisted to the instance).

modloader.name: ModLoader support
modloader.desc: Keep Risugami's ModLoader working on Java 9+ (-Dlf.modloader).

beta-forge.name: Beta Forge support
beta-forge.desc: Keep Forge for b1.7.3-b1.8.1 working on Java 9+ (-Dlf.beta-forge).

bouncycastle.name: Bouncy Castle
bouncycastle.desc: Force-enable Bouncy Castle; requires bcprov/bcutil/bctls on the classpath (-Dlf.bouncycastle).

show-notice.name: "1.6 is out" notice
show-notice.desc: Keep the "Minecraft 1.6 is out" popup in 1.5.2 (-Dlf.showNotice).

demo.name: Demo mode
demo.desc: Launch in the historical demo (trial) mode, reproducing the 12w16a-1.5.2 demo restrictions (-Dlf.demo); no effect outside that range.

skins.name: Skin handling
skins.desc: LegacyFix takes over skins and profiles; turn off when it conflicts with skin mods (on by default).

proxy.name: Network proxy
proxy.desc: Handles all HTTP/HTTPS requests that some fixes rely on; disabling them makes those fixes unavailable (on by default).

server-auth.name: Server join auth
server-auth.desc: Authenticate with Mojang when joining servers on c0.0.15a-c0.30 and a1.0.5-a1.0.15 (on by default).

fullscreen.name: Fullscreen launch
fullscreen.desc: Start the game in fullscreen mode (v1 feature, not wired yet).

game-mode-switch.name: Game mode switch
game-mode-switch.desc: Toggle creative/survival by key in Classic (v1 feature, not wired yet).

quit-game.name: Quick quit
quit-game.desc: In-game quit-to-launcher shortcut (v1 feature, not wired yet).

intelFix.name: Intel Graphics Fix
intelFix.desc: Injects -XX:HeapDumpPath on Windows to guard against Intel GPU heap-dump failures (v1 intelFix, on by default).

forceUpdate.name: Force Update
forceUpdate.desc: Re-download version files (jar/libraries/assets) on launch even when already present locally (v1 Force Update).

instance.exists: An instance with this name already exists. Edit it or choose another name.

launch.hintNeedBoth: Add a valid account and select a version first
launch.visualizerOff: The selected version jar does not contain the visualizer class (or is not downloaded yet)

launcherCrash.reportNoRepo: No repository configured — diagnostics copied to clipboard

general.dataRootDesc: Where game versions, instances and downloads live.
general.rootPending: New data root pending — takes effect after restarting the app: {path}
general.clearConfirmMessage: Deletes every .log file in the logs directory (locked files are skipped). This cannot be undone.
general.diagLogDesc: Record the launch command and output to the logs directory on every game launch for troubleshooting.

language.label: Interface language
language.hint: Applies instantly without restart, and is saved to settings.

launch.integrityDesc: Verify the sha1 of the local game jar; handle missing or corrupt files per the repair policy.
launch.fixMissingDesc: Re-download automatically when issues are found; when off, only report errors without touching files.
launch.minimizeDesc: Minimize the launcher window to the background once the game starts.
launch.consoleOnLaunchDesc: Pop up the standalone console window after a successful launch to follow LegacyFix and game logs live. Test launch always opens it, regardless of this switch.
launch.serverDesc: LegacyFix lf.proxy.levelServer: URL = online level saves; local = force local singleplayer.
launch.sysMem: Total RAM {total} MB, {free} MB currently free.
launch.memoryAutoEst: Auto mode estimates from total RAM — currently about {mb} MB.
launch.jvmGlobalDesc: Injected after fixed heap flags and before instance args; instance-level same flags win (last wins).

java.autoLockHint: The candidate list is read-only in auto mode; switch to manual to pick an install.

updateDialog.title: Check for updates
updateDialog.upToDate: You are on the latest version (v{version}).
updateDialog.found: A new version v{version} is available!
updateDialog.unconfigured: The release repository (owner/repo) is not configured — update check is unavailable.
updateDialog.ignoreHint: Ignoring records this version in a single local slot: automatic checks stay silent for it (manual check is unaffected).

updatePolicy.label: Update check policy
updatePolicy.desc: Governs only the automatic check at startup; the "Check for updates" button stays available under both policies.

about.updateSoon: The launcher auto-update system is not online yet; the channel is not selectable.
about.licenseDesc: This software is released under GNU GPL v3 (GPL-3.0-only).
about.agreementDesc: Applicable terms and important notices (v1.0, effective 2026-10-30).

ref.betacraft: Upstream Betacraft v1 launcher — source of truth for version lists, .info shape and launch semantics.
ref.legacyfix: Legacy compatibility mod — origin of every -Dlf.* behavior switch.
ref.mcanextgen: Archived predecessor repo — inherited Java detection and legacy JVM-argument knowledge.
ref.blockhelm: UI blueprint for the settings and about page layouts.
ref.hmcl: JavaFX launcher — the vanilla UUID default-skin selection behind our offline avatar fallback comes from its TexturesLoader.
ref.vue: Frontend framework — rendering and reactive state.
ref.electron: Desktop shell — main process, native dialogs and file system access.
ref.tauri: Desktop shell — Rust window layer with a Node sidecar on the system WebView.
ref.lucide: Open icon set behind the inline SVG icons.

developer.endpointsNote: Endpoint changes take effect on next app launch.

feedback.subtitle: Submit via GitHub — pick a type first.
feedback.featureDesc: Ideas and improvements — start a thread in GitHub Discussions.
